usageNotes: Use this to register a new prepared answer file in Proxmox Datacenter Manager's auto-install system, which allows bare-metal nodes to be installed unattended when they PXE-boot. Requires the System.Modify privilege on the system/auto-installation path. If you omit 'target-filter', the configuration acts as a catch-all default for any installation request not matched by a narrower config — only one such default can exist at a time, so setting 'is-default: true' will silently override any prior default.

examples.summary: Create a prepared answer for a static-IP PVE node using ZFS mirrored disks

tips: Only one prepared config may have 'is-default: true'; creating a second will overwrite the flag on the existing default.
Fields that support MiniJinja templating (fqdn, mailto, cidr, gateway, dns) are rendered at install time — use 'template-counters' to drive auto-incrementing host numbers across a fleet.
Use 'authorized-tokens' to restrict which PDM API tokens can fetch this answer file, reducing the blast radius if a token is compromised.

When 'disk-mode' is 'filter', 'disk-filter' and 'disk-filter-match' drive selection; when it is 'list', populate 'disk-list' with block device names like 'sda' or 'nvme0n1' — mixing both modes is not supported.
If 'post-hook-base-url' is an HTTPS endpoint you control, pair it with 'post-hook-cert-fp' (sha256 fingerprint) to pin the TLS certificate and prevent MITM during post-install callback.
